title: Cellulose hydrogenolysis on a combination of tungsten oxide nanorods with and without ruthenium loading for enhanced ethanol selectivity
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00265F, Paper
Ambereen A. Niaze, Mahendra K. Sunkara, Sreedevi Upadhyayula
Ru/WO3 and WO3 in combination is efficient for cellulose conversion to ethanol. We investigated the overall reaction kinetics for the integrated system. A mathematical model was developed based on the rational simplification of a reaction network.
